questions.q: Which three things make up the golden triangle?
questions.why: The golden triangle links sport, sponsorship and the media.

questions.q: Time-wasting when your team is ahead is an example of
questions.why: Gamesmanship bends the rules without breaking them to gain an advantage.

questions.q: Explain one positive and one negative effect of sponsorship on a sport.
questions.model: Positive: sponsorship brings money for facilities and professional athletes. Negative: sponsors can influence timings or rules, and may withdraw if results fall.
